title: Minecraft 26.2 Pre-Release 6
author: Java Team
imageAltText: Steve is spectating over the aftermath of a creeper explosion by a Pillager outpost with items scattered all around

blocks.source_text: Today we're shipping the 26.2 Pre-Release 6. This version includes a fix that allows proper spectating after dying in a hardcore world.
blocks.translated_text: 今天我们发布了26.2预发布版6。此版本修复了一个问题，使得在 hardcore 世界中死亡后可以正常观看其他玩家的游戏过程。

blocks.source_text: Respawning (as a spectator) in a hardcore world no longer turns off the spectators_generate_chunks game rule
blocks.translated_text: 在 hardcore 世界中以观众身份重生时，不会再禁用 `spectators.generate_chunks` 这一游戏规则

blocks.source_text: Pre-Releases are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Pre-Release, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.
blocks.translated_text: 预发布版适用于 Minecraft: Java 版。要安装预发布版，请打开[Minecraft 启动器](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download)，并在“安装”选项卡中启用快照功能。

blocks.source_text: **Testing versions can corrupt your world, so please backup and/or run them in a different folder from your main worlds.**
blocks.translated_text: **测试版本可能会损坏你的游戏世界，请备份数据，并/或将它们放在与主世界不同的文件夹中运行。**
跨平台服务器 jar 文件。

blocks.source_text: For any feedback and suggestions, head over to the [Feedback site](https://feedback.minecraft.net/) . If you're feeling chatty, join us over at the [official Minecraft Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft) .
blocks.translated_text: 如有任何反馈或建议，请访问[反馈网站](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)。如果您想交流，欢迎加入我们的[Minecraft 官方 Discord 社区](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft)。

content:
Today we're shipping the 26.2 Pre-Release 6. This version includes a fix that allows proper spectating after dying in a hardcore world.

Happy mining!

Changes

Respawning (as a spectator) in a hardcore world no longer turns off the spectators_generate_chunks game rule

Get the Pre-Release

Pre-Releases are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Pre-Release, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.

**Testing versions can corrupt your world, so please backup and/or run them in a different folder from your main worlds.**

Cross-platform server jar:

[Minecraft server jar](https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/a319e7c59c1dfebbf494857f5604a798f115edb9/server.jar)

Report bugs here:

[Minecraft issue tracker](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary) !

Want to give feedback?

For any feedback and suggestions, head over to the [Feedback site](https://feedback.minecraft.net/) . If you're feeling chatty, join us over at the [official Minecraft Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft) .
